notes:
Smoother on phones, and a Glossy or Plain shop name

- The customer page runs smoother on phones, especially in the Glass look:
  the panes are frosted without a live blur (they look the same), the
  coin ring and time bar do less work, and the page holds still behind
  pop-up sheets.
- Customer page > Font for the name has a new Style switch: Glossy (glass
  in your accent colour) or Plain (dark text).
